parts:
Hello folks,

I'm looking at the estimated sample densities provided by Distance and
comparing them to observed "density" - just the number of birds detected
at a sampling site.

There are no instances where I did not detect a bird but Distance
estimated or predicted a particular density. Is that OK? Detection
probability is ~ 0.1 and it seems like there should have been cases
where Distance had estimated densities where I did not detect any birds.
Make sense?

Thanks,

Jeff
